result.summary: This is a routine garden job: clearing rubbish, levelling the ground and laying gravel. Approval 29 has been waiting on the landlord since 17 Jan, with no reply after 3 days. This is the first missed follow-up, so I sent the landlord a reminder asking them to approve or decline a contractor visit to quote, or to pick part of the work. I also asked the tenant to resend the photos, which aren't visible in the records. The ticket is on hold until the landlord replies, with a follow-up in 3 days.
